title: Create Aeronautics Mods
description: Create Aeronautics and More... It Includes many Create Addons including Create Aeronautics as the Core Mod.
body:
# Create Aeronautics Mods
This Modpack Contains **MANY** mods that all serve a purpose in this modpack.
With **[Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create/versions)** and **[Create Aeronautics](https://modrinth.com/project/oWaK0Q19)** as the Centre of It.
Many Mods like **[CC: Tweaked](https://modrinth.com/mod/cc-tweaked/versions)** are Mods that can Serve Many more Purposes than it Shows.

Many Mods serve a Purpose in this modpack like Create Aeronautics being the Main Mod except some Mods like CC: Tweaked complement it there are many other mods like Jade, JEI, Sodium, and many other Optimisation mods to make the experience as enjoyable as possible.
You should Download this if you want to have fun.
There are no overbearing problems with this modpack so please have fun.
The purpose for making this modpack is to be a fun experience with the create aeronautics mod and for me to learn how to use the create mod and computer craft.

This Modpack was made for Fun.
